verdict.rationale: Evidence shows full AP capability: bill capture/coding (Invoice Coding Agent), custom approval policies, vendor network payments, and multiple disbursement methods including ACH-style ePayments, checks written via BILL account, and wire/funding via bank connections — all within the same platform alongside S&E. missing for 10: explicit first-party confirmation of wire transfer as a distinct payment rail (only checks, ePayments, and network payments are explicitly documented) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
